title: ODNI's COVID files show funding and contacts, not a proven lab origin
adds: The June 12 and June 18, 2026 ODNI releases add real records on NIH funding of EcoHealth work with the Wuhan Institute of Virology (WIV), Fauci's contacts with intelligence analysts, complaint handling and U.S. support for labs in Ukraine. They do not prove a lab origin, that Fauci controlled intelligence findings, or that he lied to Congress.
